family_reports.body: Broken systems have allowed my children to be entangled in abuse.

My kids are still at risk and I have to come up with more money to make sure he cant have custody as he is a abusive, addict with mental issues. If something were to happen to me they would have to go with him and he will ruin them.

My ex husband has taken everything he threatened to with the exception of the lives of the children and I. I am terrified to fight back because I recognize all prior threats made were followed through on. I have to choose between staying silent or risking him ending our lives. It’s no place for any parent or child to exist in.
